about: Hi, I'm Yaz, a digital artist sharing my favourite pieces here.
commissionText: Commissions are open! Send me a message or a commission request below and I'll reply right here on the site. You can also support my work on Ko-fi.
commissionClosedText: Commissions are closed for now, but you can still send me a message below. Follow me on Instagram or TikTok to hear when they reopen.
contactIntro: Questions, collabs or commission ideas: write to me here. You'll get a private link where my replies show up.
